description: The image is a false-colour infrared satellite or aerial photograph displaying an agricultural landscape with water features. A large blue linear feature, likely a river or canal, runs horizontally across the upper part. Adjacent to this linear feature, a dark blue, irregularly shaped water body is labelled, with an arrow pointing to it. The label identifies this as "Bare soil = active quarry" which corresponds to classification "8.2.4 Standing water bodies of extractive industrial sites". Further south in the image, a cluster of smaller, dark, elongated water bodies is visible within reddish agricultural fields. These are labelled as "Naturalized ponds" which correspond to classification "8.2.1 Natural lakes". Red areas in the image indicate healthy vegetation, typical of agricultural fields in false-colour infrared. The image demonstrates the visual distinction and classification criteria for different types of water bodies in a Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) mapping context.
